name: Blenda 4D (free motion-design layout add-on for Blender)
summary: GPL add-on that gives regular Blender a Cinema 4D-style motion-design workflow: command bar, Object/Attribute/Material Managers, 17 parametric primitives, 12 parametric splines, live generators (Extrude, Lathe, Sweep, Loft, Boolean, Array...), deformers (Bend, Twist, Taper...), a Sky object, asset browser and render presets. One switch returns to standard Blender. No fork, nothing to compile. MoClone cloner and full timeline not yet ported (roadmap).

access.notes: GPL-3.0-or-later (per LICENSE and blender_manifest.toml); free to use for commercial work, modified redistributions must stay GPL. Requires Blender 5.2 LTS+. Tested on Mac/Linux, Windows testers wanted.

procedure: Download blenda4d-0.1.0.zip from the GitHub latest release
In Blender: Edit > Preferences > Add-ons > Install from Disk, pick the zip
Use the Blenda 4D | Blender switch at top right to toggle layouts

verdict.why: Brings a C4D-like motion-design workflow to free Blender as a plain add-on (previously a waitlisted fork, now GPL). Brand new v0.1 (source went up this morning), so expect gaps (no cloner yet), but downloadable, documented and genuinely differentiated.
